content: {"praised":["Julia McKenzie brings intelligence and soft fluffiness to Marple.","Her portrayal is not schoolmarmish, but charmingly feminine.","The series offers pure fun and period accuracy.","Three new adventures keep the mystery engaging.","The tone remains classic, well‑mannered and witty."],"criticized":["Plot is hard to follow and confusing.","Too many actors doing nothing add to confusion.","Scripts and production are subpar compared to earlier series.","The episode feels like a hubris, shoe‑horned Marple.","Overall quality is considered the worst of the series."]}
